title: Self-configuring high-speed multi-plane light conversion
core_idea: Introduce a self-configuring MPLC architecture that uses multi-plane wavefront shaping—reshaping multiple spatial light modulators simultaneously—and a high-speed (kHz-rate) phase-only modulation platform to enable rapid convergence while absorbing unknown misalignments and aberrations, with the goal of implementing arbitrary unitary optical transformations such as universal mode sorting.
tldr: A self-configuring, high-speed MPLC approach combining multi-plane wavefront shaping and kHz phase-only modulation to rapidly design robust unitary optical transformations for communications, computing and imaging.
